placements.title: Adopting the Velociraptor Retrospective Format for Engineering Reflection
placements.frame: How does adopting the Velociraptor retrospective format structure team reflection and process iteration across sprints?
placements.why: The segments collectively establish the team's procedural switch to the Velociraptor retrospective format (structured around Sailed, Stalled, and Capsized) to replace the legacy start-stop-continue model.
